summary: Big Digital Energy, Inc. (BGDE) filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, reporting the issuance and sale of 16,700 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock at $900 per share (stated value $1,000) to Six Thirty AI, LLC, an entity controlled by insiders (Executive Chairman, CEO, COO). Gross proceeds were $15.03 million, with a five-year warrant to purchase 926,748 common shares at $10.81 (120% of closing price). The transaction was exempt under Section 4(a)(2). A Special Transactions Committee of disinterested directors approved the deal. This private placement, structured as a convertible preferred equity raise with warrants, is akin to a capital return event (equity financing). Watch for dilution from conversion and warrant exercise, which may pressure the stock and require shareholder approval if conversion volume exceeds thresholds.
